tools.name: RunAppTests
tools.description: Replay saved app recordings, or explicit reserved suite __platform_smoke__ for page visibility and immediate JavaScript errors only, without workflow coverage. Explicit project required. Poll GetAppTestRun; NO_TESTS and skipped workflows never count as passes.

suite.description: Saved recording UUID/name, or __platform_smoke__ for a limited platform-owned page visibility check; omitted only runs saved recordings

outputSchema.description: runId, explicit target, status and maxFixAttempts

tools.name: GetAppTestRun
tools.description: Read a caller-owned run. RUNNING, COMPLETED, ERROR or NO_TESTS. Check counts/classifications; action-only recordings are SKIPPED/NO_ASSERTIONS. scope PAGE_VISIBILITY_SMOKE verifies page visibility only and provides no saved workflow coverage; always report this limited scope.

outputSchema.description: Caller-owned report with target, status, summary, tests and optional reason/evidence

tools.name: ListAppTestRecordings
tools.description: List recorded workflows and their checks for an explicit app.

tools.name: SaveAppTestRecording
tools.description: Save a recorded workflow with optional assertions. Do not change tests merely to hide app failures.

recording.description: version 1: optional id, name, startPath, steps

outputSchema.description: Saved id, version, name, startPath, steps, updatedAt

tools.name: DeleteAppTestRecording
tools.description: Delete a recording only when explicitly requested; never remove tests to make a run pass.
